title: Make special end-user-facing KIO protocols (tags:/ applications:/ fonts:/ etc) discoverable in config UI
line: Folder View's location list now offers Applications, Fonts and Tags, so the desktop or a Folder View widget can show them without typing a URL.
explanation: The location page of Folder View (and the desktop's Layout page) only offered the Places panel entries, so special KIO locations like applications:/, fonts:/ and tags:/ worked only if users knew to type them as a custom location. PlacesModel now concatenates the places with a small list of these locations, added only when their KIO worker is installed, and urlForIndex/indexForUrl read the URL role so a saved choice is shown again when the settings reopen. A Places panel entry with the same URL is hidden to avoid a duplicate.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: list Applications, Fonts and Tags as locations

Showing applications:/, fonts:/ or tags:/ in Folder View was only
possible by typing the URL as a custom location, so few people knew
about it. List these locations after the places in the location combo.

BUG: 360355

With the fix: Applications, Fonts and Tags are listed after the places
Desktop showing the Desktop folder (the only way to get applications:/ was typing it)
